Pride Group Homes, Villas and Plotted Developments

Pride Group is a leading real estate developer in India, founded in 1993 under the visionary leadership of Mr. Arvind Jain. Over the past three decades, the group has established a strong presence across Pune, Bengaluru, and Mumbai, delivering premium residential and commercial landmarks.

Driven by its motto, "Building Tomorrow. Today.," Pride Group focuses on cutting-edge design, high-quality construction standards, and strategic urban locations to craft vibrant communities and modern lifestyle spaces.

Architectural Overview

Pride Green Avenue (also known as Pride Green Avenues) is a premium 15-acre BMRDA and RERA-approved plotted development by Pride Group. Located in Jigani, off Bannerghatta Road in South Bengaluru, the community comprises 266 Vastu-compliant plots with tree-lined avenues, 5 landscaped parks, wide internal concrete roads, and a luxury clubhouse. Buyers researching Pride group plots in Bangalore can explore Pride Group developments in Jigani, Bengaluru, with project status, location, and configuration details available to compare.

Pride Green Avenue is listed with Residential Plots across 15 Acres, with new launch status and possession shown as June 2026. Listed layout options include 30 x 40 Plot (West Facing), 30 x 40 Plot (East Facing) and 30 x 50 Plot (West Facing). Residents can explore amenities such as Clubhouse, Landscaped Parks, Jogging & Walking Track and Gymnasium, with nearby destinations including Bannerghatta Main Road (4.0 Kms), Jigani Industrial Area (9.8 Kms) and Bannerghatta National Park (9.2 Kms). Review Pride Group floor plans, amenities, and connectivity when comparing homes and plots in Bengaluru. RERA Registration No. PRM/KA/RERA/1251/308/PR/250725/007951
